legend: Dominoes are tile numbers 1-48, the number on the back of the tile. Boards are rows top to bottom separated by '/', each square a letter (W farm (wheat), F field (grassland), T forest, M mine, L lake, S swamp, C castle, . empty) then its crowns. pile is the draw pile in order, null once taken; order is the seats in the order they pick. A move takes `domino` from `pile` at `position` and is option `turn` of `options` as generated by GameState::possible_turns, so games can be replayed. placed lists the new squares as [landscape, crowns, rows up from the castle, columns right of the castle], empty when the domino fits nowhere. boards and scores are from before the move, board is the mover's board after it.
